listing.name: Dragon Ball Z: Burst Limit (DBZ Burst Limit Recompiled)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Windows native package; Linux ZIP uses Wine Limits: US Xbox 360 version only. Linux package is Wine/DXVK/vkd3d-proton, not a native Linux binary. Upstream platforms: Native Windows10/11 x86-64 package; Linux ZIP runs that Windows runtime through Wine/DXVK/vkd3d-proton, not a native Linux binary. Original data: Own Dragon Ball Z: Burst Limit Xbox 360 USA/NTSC-U disc and complete extracted data folder. default.xex SHA-1 must be aec598f88cf51181fc377b148e0b1ad30db4485c; it is also needed for source compilation. European/PAL and Japanese builds have incompatible addresses. Original disc data remains required at runtime. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
